duty_note: Edit these to match the current Indian import duty. Not live values. Gold/silver 15% as of 2026-11-24; copper is an unverified assumption. GST is not included.
premium_note: Fixed local premium over import cost, in percent. Median gap of 23 MCX daily closes (20 Oct - 23 Nov 2026) vs COMEX x USD/INR x (1+duty). It drifts: re-measure now and then and update premium_set.
events_note: Irregular committee/agency dates - refresh from official calendars (federalreserve.gov, rbi.org.in, bls.gov, bea.gov, mospi.gov.in) as new ones are published. India CPI, China PMI and NSE F&O expiry are computed by rule in fetch_data.py instead, since those follow a fixed day-of-month/weekday pattern.
